<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
<title>FIRA RoboWorld Malaysia 2027 — Sponsorship</title>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js"></script>
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#000; --card:#111113; --card2:#0b0b0c; --ink:#f2f3f5; --muted:#9aa0ab; --line:#26272b;
    --brand:#3b82f6; --brand-ink:#fff; --danger:#ff6b6b; --ok:#34d399; --radius:14px;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  html{color-scheme:dark}
  body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif}
  .wrap{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px}

  .topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;background:rgba(0,0,0,.85);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .bar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;height:52px}
  .brand{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.3px}
  .lang{display:flex;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden}
  .lang button{background:none;border:0;color:var(--muted);padding:6px 14px;font:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
  .lang button.on{background:var(--brand);color:#fff}

  .hero{position:relative;background:#000}
  .hero img{display:block;width:100%;height:clamp(150px,26vw,230px);object-fit:cover}
  .hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(0,0,0,.15),#000 96%)}
  .heroText{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:14px;z-index:2}
  .heroText h1{margin:0;font-size:clamp(22px,5vw,32px);line-height:1.2}
  .heroText p{margin:4px 0 0;color:#c4c9d4;font-size:14px}

  main{padding:8px 0 56px}
  .card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:24px}
  .sec{margin-bottom:28px}
  .sec h2{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
  .sec h2 i{font-style:normal;background:var(--brand);color:#fff;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px}
  label{display:block;font-weight:600;margin:14px 0 6px;font-size:14px}
  .grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 14px}
  input[type=text],input[type=email],input[type=tel]{
    width:100%;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;font:inherit;background:var(--card2);color:var(--ink)}
  input::placeholder{color:#5d626d}
  input:focus{outline:2px solid var(--brand);border-color:transparent}

  .pkgs{display:grid;gap:10px}
  .pkg{border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;cursor:pointer;background:var(--card2);text-align:left;font:inherit;color:inherit;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}
  .pkg.sel{border-color:var(--brand);background:#0d1830}
  .pkg b{font-size:16px}
  .pkg small{display:block;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;font-size:13px}
  .pkg .price{font-weight:700;color:var(--brand);white-space:nowrap}
  .choices{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
  .choice{border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:14px;cursor:pointer;background:var(--card2);text-align:left;font:inherit;color:inherit}
  .choice b{display:block}
  .choice span{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
  .choice.sel{border-color:var(--brand);background:#0d1830}

  .detail{margin-top:14px;padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--card2)}
  .detail label:first-child{margin-top:0}
  .note{background:#1c1606;border:1px solid #4a3a10;color:#e8cf8a;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:14px;margin-top:10px}
  .drop{border:2px dashed #34363c;border-radius:12px;padding:24px 16px;text-align:center;background:#0e0e10;cursor:pointer}
  .drop.has{border-style:solid;border-color:var(--ok);background:#0a1a14}
  .drop small{color:var(--muted)}

  .sigbox{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden}
  canvas.sig{display:block;width:100%;height:170px;touch-action:none}
  .sigtools{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:6px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
  .sigtools button{background:none;border:0;color:var(--brand);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font:inherit}
  .check{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;margin-top:16px;font-size:14px;font-weight:400}
  .check input{margin-top:4px;accent-color:var(--brand);width:18px;height:18px;flex:0 0 auto}

  .err{color:var(--danger);font-size:14px;margin-top:10px;min-height:1.2em}
  button.btn{width:100%;padding:15px 18px;border:0;border-radius:10px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;background:var(--brand);color:var(--brand-ink);font-size:16px;margin-top:6px}
  button.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line)}
  button.btn:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
  .hidden{display:none}
  .done{text-align:center;padding:16px 0}
  .done .tick{width:68px;height:68px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ok);color:#052e1d;font-size:36px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 12px}
  .done p{color:var(--muted)}
  .done .btn{margin-top:10px}
  @media (max-width:560px){.grid2,.choices{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="topbar"><div class="wrap bar">
  <span class="brand">IRIS ITS</span>
  <div class="lang" role="group" aria-label="Language">
    <button type="button" data-lang="id">ID</button>
    <button type="button" data-lang="en">EN</button>
  </div>
</div></div>

<header class="hero">
  <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="IRIS Team ITS">
  <div class="heroText"><div class="wrap">
    <h1 id="evName"></h1>
    <p data-i18n="tagline"></p>
  </div></div>
</header>

<main><div class="wrap">
  <div class="card">
    <div id="formView">

      <div class="sec">
        <h2><i>1</i><span data-i18n="s1"></span></h2>
        <label for="company" data-i18n="lblCompany"></label>
        <input type="text" id="company" autocomplete="organization" data-i18n-ph="phCompany">
        <div class="grid2">
          <div><label for="pic" data-i18n="lblPic"></label>
          <input type="text" id="pic" autocomplete="name" data-i18n-ph="phPic"></div>
          <div><label for="picTitle" data-i18n="lblPicTitle"></label>
          <input type="text" id="picTitle" data-i18n-ph="phPicTitle"></div>
          <div><label for="email" data-i18n="lblEmail"></label>
          <input type="email" id="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="nama@perusahaan.com"></div>
          <div><label for="phone" data-i18n="lblPhone"></label>
          <input type="tel" id="phone" autocomplete="tel" placeholder="08xxxxxxxxxx"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="sec">
        <h2><i>2</i><span data-i18n="s2"></span></h2>
        <label data-i18n="lblPackage"></label>
        <div class="pkgs" id="pkgs"></div>

        <label data-i18n="lblForm"></label>
        <div class="choices">
          <button type="button" class="choice" data-type="uang"><b>💰 Fresh Money</b><span data-i18n="fmDesc"></span></button>
          <button type="button" class="choice" data-type="barang"><b>📦 <span data-i18n="gdName"></span></b><span data-i18n="gdDesc"></span></button>
        </div>

        <div class="detail hidden" id="dMoney">
          <label for="nominal" data-i18n="lblNominal"></label>
          <input type="text" id="nominal" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="Rp 0">
          <div class="note" id="rangeNote"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="detail hidden" id="dGoods">
          <label data-i18n="lblUpload"></label>
          <div class="drop" id="drop"></div>
          <input type="file" id="file" class="hidden" accept=".pdf,.doc,.docx,.xls,.xlsx,.csv,.png,.jpg,.jpeg">
          <label for="goodsValue" data-i18n="lblGoodsValue"></label>
          <input type="text" id="goodsValue" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="Rp 0">
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="sec" style="margin-bottom:8px">
        <h2><i>3</i><span data-i18n="s3"></span></h2>
        <label data-i18n="lblSign"></label>
        <div class="sigbox"><canvas class="sig" id="sigP"></canvas></div>
        <div class="sigtools"><span id="sigName"></span><button type="button" id="clearSig" data-i18n="clear"></button></div>
        <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="agree"> <span data-i18n="agree"></span></label>
      </div>

      <div class="err" id="err" role="alert"></div>
      <button class="btn" id="send"></button>
    </div>

    <div id="doneView" class="done hidden">
      <div class="tick">✓</div>
      <h2 data-i18n="thanks"></h2>
      <p id="doneMsg"></p>
      <button class="btn" id="dl" data-i18n="dlBtn"></button>
      <button class="btn ghost" onclick="location.reload()" data-i18n="newForm"></button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div></main>

<script>
/* =====================================================
   PENGATURAN / SETTINGS
   ===================================================== */
const BANNER = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";
const CONFIG = {
  eventName: "FIRA RoboWorld Malaysia 2027",
  orgName: "IRIS",
  orgShort: "IRIS ITS",
  organizerEmail: "irisrobotic@gmail.com",
  city: "Surabaya",
  // Alamat backend (POST multipart/form-data) untuk menyimpan data & mengirim email otomatis. Kosongkan jika belum ada.
  submitEndpoint: "",
  packages: [
    { id:"gold",   name:"GOLD",   min:35000000, max:50000000,
      benefits:{ id:["Logo feed","Logo video","Logo postingan khusus","Logo body mobil"],
                 en:["Logo on feed","Logo on video","Logo on special post","Logo on car body"] } },
    { id:"silver", name:"SILVER", min:15000000, max:25000000,
      benefits:{ id:["Logo feed","Logo video","Logo postingan khusus","Logo body mobil"],
                 en:["Logo on feed","Logo on video","Logo on special post","Logo on car body"] } },
    { id:"bronze", name:"BRONZE", min:3000000,  max:10000000,
      benefits:{ id:["Logo feed","Logo video","Logo postingan khusus"],
                 en:["Logo on feed","Logo on video","Logo on special post"] } }
  ]
};

const rupiah = n => "Rp " + Number(n||0).toLocaleString("id-ID");
const I18N = {
  id:{
    tagline:"WANI BUDAL WANI MATI, IRIS JUARA HARGA MATI",
    s1:"Data Mitra", s2:"Package & Bentuk Sponsorship", s3:"Tanda Tangan",

    lblEmail:"Email (untuk menerima dokumen)", lblPhone:"Nomor telepon / WhatsApp",
    phCompany:"PT Contoh Maju Jaya", phPic:"Nama lengkap", phPicTitle:"Contoh: Marketing Manager",
    lblPackage:"Package sponsorship", lblForm:"Bentuk sponsorship",
    fmDesc:"Dukungan dalam bentuk dana tunai", gdName:"Barang", gdDesc:"Dukungan dalam bentuk barang / produk",
    lblNominal:"Nominal sponsorship (Rupiah)",
    lblUpload:"Dokumen daftar barang (PDF, Word, Excel, atau gambar)",
    uploadEmpty:"Ketuk untuk memilih file", uploadMax:"Maksimal 10 MB", uploadChange:"ketuk untuk mengganti",
    lblGoodsValue:"Perkiraan total nilai barang (opsional, Rupiah)",
    lblSign:"Tanda tangan Anda (PIHAK KEDUA)", clear:"Hapus",
    agree:"Saya menyatakan bahwa data di atas benar dan menyetujui ketentuan kerja sama sponsorship ini.",
    send:"Kirim", sending:"Memproses…",
    thanks:"Terima kasih!", dlBtn:"Unduh Lembar Persetujuan (PDF)", newForm:"Isi formulir baru",
    doneLocal:"Lembar persetujuan Anda telah dibuat. Silakan unduh dokumennya di bawah ini.",
    doneSent:e=>`Lembar persetujuan telah dikirim ke ${e}. Anda juga dapat mengunduhnya di bawah ini.`,
    rangeNote:p=>`Package ${p.name}: nominal ${rupiah(p.min)} – ${rupiah(p.max)}.`,
    rangeNoPkg:"Pilih package terlebih dahulu untuk melihat rentang nominal.",
    eCompany:"Nama perusahaan wajib diisi.", ePic:"Nama penanggung jawab wajib diisi.",
    eEmail:"Masukkan alamat email yang valid.", ePkg:"Pilih package sponsorship.",
    eType:"Pilih bentuk sponsorship: Fresh Money atau Barang.",
    eNominal:"Masukkan nominal sponsorship.",
    eRange:p=>`Nominal harus berada pada rentang package ${p.name} (${rupiah(p.min)} – ${rupiah(p.max)}). Pilih package lain atau sesuaikan nominal.`,
    eFile:"Unggah dokumen daftar barang terlebih dahulu.", eFileSize:"Ukuran file melebihi 10 MB.",
    eSign:"Tanda tangan Anda diperlukan.", eAgree:"Centang pernyataan persetujuan terlebih dahulu.",
    eSend:m=>`Gagal mengirim: ${m}. Coba lagi.`,
    // PDF
    pdfTitle:"LEMBAR PERSETUJUAN SPONSORSHIP", pdfNo:"No. Dokumen", pdfDate:"Tanggal",
    pdfOrg:"PIHAK PERTAMA", pdfPartner:"PIHAK KEDUA", pdfDetail:"RINCIAN SPONSORSHIP", pdfTerms:"KETENTUAN",
    kOrgName:"Nama tim", kParty:"Institusi", vParty:"Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember", kSignatory:"Penandatangan", vSignatory:"Ketua Tim Riset", kEmail:"Email",
    kCompany:"Nama perusahaan", kPic:"Penanggung jawab", kPhone:"Telepon",
    kPackage:"Package", kBenefit:"Benefit", kForm:"Bentuk sponsorship", vMoney:"Fresh Money", vGoods:"Barang",
    kNominal:"Nominal", kGoodsDoc:"Dokumen daftar barang", kAttached:"terlampir", kGoodsValue:"Perkiraan nilai barang",
    sigOrg:"PIHAK PERTAMA", sigPartner:"PIHAK KEDUA", sigFoot:"Dokumen ini ditandatangani secara elektronik pada",
    terms:[
      "PIHAK PERTAMA dalam dokumen ini adalah pihak tim riset IRIS Robotic dan PIHAK KEDUA adalah pihak mitra yang bekerjasama.",
      "PIHAK KEDUA bersedia memberikan dukungan sponsorship sesuai bentuk dan rincian yang tercantum dalam lembar persetujuan ini.",
      "PIHAK PERTAMA memberikan benefit publikasi sesuai package sponsorship yang dipilih PIHAK KEDUA.",
      "Untuk sponsorship Fresh Money, pembayaran dilakukan sesuai waktu dan metode yang dikomunikasikan PIHAK PERTAMA.",
      "Untuk sponsorship Barang, daftar barang mengacu pada dokumen lampiran dan diserahkan sesuai jadwal yang disepakati.",
      "Perubahan atas kesepakatan ini hanya sah apabila disetujui secara tertulis oleh kedua belah pihak.",
      "Tanda tangan elektronik pada dokumen ini dianggap sah dan mengikat kedua belah pihak."
    ]
  },
  en:{
    tagline:"WANI BUDAL WANI MATI, IRIS JUARA HARGA MATI",
    s1:"Partner Details", s2:"Package & Sponsorship Type", s3:"Signature",
    lblCompany:"Company name", lblPic:"Person in charge", lblPicTitle:"Position of person in charge",
    lblEmail:"Email (to receive the document)", lblPhone:"Phone / WhatsApp number",
    phCompany:"Example Company Ltd.", phPic:"Full name", phPicTitle:"e.g. Marketing Manager",
    lblPackage:"Sponsorship package", lblForm:"Sponsorship type",
    fmDesc:"Support in the form of cash funds", gdName:"Goods", gdDesc:"Support in the form of goods / products",
    lblNominal:"Sponsorship amount (Rupiah)",
    lblUpload:"Goods list document (PDF, Word, Excel, or image)",
    uploadEmpty:"Tap to choose a file", uploadMax:"Maximum 10 MB", uploadChange:"tap to change",
    lblGoodsValue:"Estimated total value of goods (optional, Rupiah)",
    lblSign:"Your signature (SECOND PARTY)", clear:"Clear",
    agree:"I confirm that the information above is correct and I agree to the terms of this sponsorship agreement.",
    send:"Submit", sending:"Processing…",
    thanks:"Thank you!", dlBtn:"Download Agreement Sheet (PDF)", newForm:"Fill in a new form",
    doneLocal:"Your agreement sheet has been created. Please download it below.",
    doneSent:e=>`The agreement sheet has been sent to ${e}. You can also download it below.`,
    rangeNote:p=>`${p.name} package: amount ${rupiah(p.min)} – ${rupiah(p.max)}.`,
    rangeNoPkg:"Choose a package first to see the amount range.",
    eCompany:"Company name is required.", ePic:"Person in charge is required.",
    eEmail:"Enter a valid email address.", ePkg:"Choose a sponsorship package.",
    eType:"Choose a sponsorship type: Fresh Money or Goods.",
    eNominal:"Enter the sponsorship amount.",
    eRange:p=>`The amount must be within the ${p.name} package range (${rupiah(p.min)} – ${rupiah(p.max)}). Choose another package or adjust the amount.`,
    eFile:"Upload the goods list document first.", eFileSize:"File size exceeds 10 MB.",
    eSign:"Your signature is required.", eAgree:"Please tick the agreement statement first.",
    eSend:m=>`Failed to submit: ${m}. Please try again.`,
    pdfTitle:"SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT SHEET", pdfNo:"Document No.", pdfDate:"Date",
    pdfOrg:"FIRST PARTY", pdfPartner:"SECOND PARTY", pdfDetail:"SPONSORSHIP DETAILS", pdfTerms:"TERMS",
    kOrgName:"Team name", kParty:"Institution", vParty:"Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember", kSignatory:"Signatory", vSignatory:"Head of Research Team", kEmail:"Email",
    kCompany:"Company name", kPic:"Person in charge", kPhone:"Phone",
    kPackage:"Package", kBenefit:"Benefits", kForm:"Sponsorship type", vMoney:"Fresh Money", vGoods:"Goods",
    kNominal:"Amount", kGoodsDoc:"Goods list document", kAttached:"attached", kGoodsValue:"Estimated goods value",
    sigOrg:"FIRST PARTY", sigPartner:"SECOND PARTY", sigFoot:"This document was signed electronically on",
    terms:[
      "The FIRST PARTY in this document is the IRIS Robotic research team and the SECOND PARTY is the collaborating partner.",
      "The SECOND PARTY agrees to provide sponsorship support in the form and details stated in this agreement sheet.",
      "The FIRST PARTY provides publicity benefits according to the sponsorship package chosen by the SECOND PARTY.",
      "For Fresh Money sponsorship, payment is made according to the time and method communicated by the FIRST PARTY.",
      "For Goods sponsorship, the goods list follows the attached document and is delivered on the agreed schedule.",
      "Changes to this agreement are valid only if approved in writing by both parties.",
      "Electronic signatures on this document are deemed valid and binding on both parties."
    ]
  }
};

/* ================= STATE ================= */
const state = { lang:"id", package:null, type:null, file:null, pdfBlob:null, docNo:"" };
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const t = k => I18N[state.lang][k];
const digits = s => Number(String(s).replace(/\D/g,"")) || 0;
const fmtDate = d => d.toLocaleDateString(state.lang==="id"?"id-ID":"en-GB",{day:"numeric",month:"long",year:"numeric"});
const esc = s => s.replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]));

/* ================= BAHASA ================= */
function renderPkgs(){
  $("pkgs").innerHTML="";
  CONFIG.packages.forEach(p=>{
    const b=document.createElement("button"); b.type="button"; b.className="pkg"+(state.package&&state.package.id===p.id?" sel":"");
    b.innerHTML=`<span><b>${p.name}</b><small>${esc(p.benefits[state.lang].join(" • "))}</small></span><span class="price">${rupiah(p.min)} – ${rupiah(p.max)}</span>`;
    b.onclick=()=>{state.package=p; renderPkgs(); renderRange();};
    $("pkgs").appendChild(b);
  });
}
function renderRange(){ $("rangeNote").textContent = state.package ? t("rangeNote")(state.package) : t("rangeNoPkg"); }
function renderDrop(){
  const f=state.file;
  $("drop").classList.toggle("has",!!f);
  $("drop").innerHTML = f
    ? `<b>✓ ${esc(f.name)}</b><br><small>${(f.size/1024).toFixed(0)} KB — ${t("uploadChange")}</small>`
    : `<b>${t("uploadEmpty")}</b><br><small>${t("uploadMax")}</small>`;
}
function applyLang(l){
  state.lang=l; document.documentElement.lang=l;
  try{localStorage.setItem("lang",l);}catch(e){}
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n]").forEach(n=>n.textContent=t(n.dataset.i18n));
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n-ph]").forEach(n=>n.placeholder=t(n.dataset.i18nPh));
  document.querySelectorAll(".lang button").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("on",b.dataset.lang===l));
  $("send").textContent=t("send"); $("err").textContent="";
  renderPkgs(); renderRange(); renderDrop();
  if(state.doneEmail!==undefined) $("doneMsg").textContent = state.doneEmail ? t("doneSent")(state.doneEmail) : t("doneLocal");
}
document.querySelectorAll(".lang button").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>applyLang(b.dataset.lang));
$("evName").textContent=CONFIG.eventName;

/* ================= FORM ================= */
document.querySelectorAll(".choice").forEach(c=>c.onclick=()=>{
  state.type=c.dataset.type;
  document.querySelectorAll(".choice").forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle("sel",x===c));
  $("dMoney").classList.toggle("hidden",state.type!=="uang");
  $("dGoods").classList.toggle("hidden",state.type!=="barang");
});
function money(i){ i.addEventListener("input",()=>{const v=digits(i.value); i.value=v?rupiah(v):"";}); }
money($("nominal")); money($("goodsValue"));
$("pic").addEventListener("input",()=>$("sigName").textContent=$("pic").value.trim());

$("drop").onclick=()=>$("file").click();
$("file").onchange=()=>{
  const f=$("file").files[0]; $("err").textContent=""; if(!f) return;
  if(f.size>10*1024*1024){ $("file").value=""; state.file=null; renderDrop(); $("err").textContent=t("eFileSize"); return; }
  state.file=f; renderDrop();
};

/* ================= TANDA TANGAN MITRA ================= */
function makePad(canvas){
  const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d"); let drawing=false, dirty=false, last=null;
  function fit(){
    const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;
    if(!r.width) return;
    const keep=dirty?canvas.toDataURL():null;
    canvas.width=r.width*dpr; canvas.height=r.height*dpr;
    ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
    ctx.lineWidth=2.2; ctx.lineCap="round"; ctx.lineJoin="round"; ctx.strokeStyle="#0b1a4a";
    if(keep){const i=new Image(); i.onload=()=>ctx.drawImage(i,0,0,r.width,r.height); i.src=keep;}
  }
  const pos=e=>{const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); return {x:e.clientX-r.left,y:e.clientY-r.top};};
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{drawing=true; last=pos(e); canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(last.x,last.y,1.1,0,6.3); ctx.fillStyle="#0b1a4a"; ctx.fill(); dirty=true;});
  canvas.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{ if(!drawing) return; const p=pos(e);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(last.x,last.y); ctx.lineTo(p.x,p.y); ctx.stroke(); last=p; });
  ["pointerup","pointercancel"].forEach(ev=>canvas.addEventListener(ev,()=>drawing=false));
  return { fit, clear(){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); ctx.clearRect(0,0,r.width,r.height); dirty=false;},
           isEmpty:()=>!dirty, data:()=>canvas.toDataURL("image/png") };
}
const pad=makePad($("sigP"));
$("clearSig").onclick=()=>pad.clear();
window.addEventListener("resize",()=>pad.fit());

/* ================= TANDA TANGAN PENYELENGGARA (OTOMATIS, ACAK) ================= */
function randomSignature(){
  const c=document.createElement("canvas"); c.width=600; c.height=200; const x=c.getContext("2d");
  const R=(a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a);
  x.strokeStyle="#0b1a4a"; x.lineCap="round"; x.lineJoin="round";
  const loops=Math.floor(R(4,8)), N=loops*7, ph=R(0,6.28), pts=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=N;i++){
    const u=i/N, amp=R(26,58)*(1-0.45*u);
    pts.push({x:40+u*470+R(-5,5), y:100+Math.sin(u*loops*6.283+ph)*amp*Math.sin(Math.PI*u*0.92+0.25)+R(-4,4)});
  }
  x.lineWidth=R(2.4,3.4); x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(pts[0].x,pts[0].y);
  for(let i=1;i<pts.length-1;i++){ const m={x:(pts[i].x+pts[i+1].x)/2,y:(pts[i].y+pts[i+1].y)/2}; x.quadraticCurveTo(pts[i].x,pts[i].y,m.x,m.y); }
  x.stroke();
  x.lineWidth=R(1.6,2.4); x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(R(40,90),R(150,168));
  x.quadraticCurveTo(R(220,380),R(128,178),R(480,560),R(138,162)); x.stroke();
  return c.toDataURL("image/png");
}

/* ================= PDF (SATU HALAMAN) ================= */
function buildPDF(sigPartner){
  const {jsPDF}=window.jspdf; const doc=new jsPDF({unit:"mm",format:"a4"});
  const W=210, M=18, TW=W-2*M; let y;
  const now=new Date();
  state.docNo="SPN/"+now.getFullYear()+String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")+"/"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7).toUpperCase();
  const company=$("company").value.trim(), pic=$("pic").value.trim(), picTitle=$("picTitle").value.trim();

  doc.addImage(BANNER,"JPEG",0,0,W,W*286/2000);
  y=W*286/2000+10;
  doc.setTextColor(20); doc.setFont("helvetica","bold"); doc.setFontSize(15);
  doc.text(t("pdfTitle"),W/2,y,{align:"center"}); y+=6;
  doc.setFont("helvetica","normal"); doc.setFontSize(10.5); doc.setTextColor(70);
  doc.text(CONFIG.eventName,W/2,y,{align:"center"}); y+=8;
  doc.setFontSize(9); doc.setTextColor(30);
  doc.text(t("pdfNo")+" : "+state.docNo,M,y); doc.text(t("pdfDate")+" : "+fmtDate(now),W-M,y,{align:"right"}); y+=7;

  const heading=s=>{doc.setFont("helvetica","bold"); doc.setFontSize(10); doc.setTextColor(20); doc.text(s,M,y); y+=1.8; doc.setDrawColor(190); doc.line(M,y,W-M,y); y+=5; doc.setFont("helvetica","normal"); doc.setFontSize(9.5);};
  const kv=(k,v)=>{const lines=doc.splitTextToSize(String(v),TW-46); doc.setTextColor(110); doc.text(k,M,y); doc.setTextColor(20); doc.text(lines,M+46,y); y+=Math.max(5,lines.length*4.5);};

  heading(t("pdfOrg"));
  kv(t("kOrgName"),CONFIG.orgName); kv(t("kParty"),t("vParty")); kv(t("kSignatory"),t("vSignatory")); kv(t("kEmail"),CONFIG.organizerEmail);
  y+=3; heading(t("pdfPartner"));
  kv(t("kCompany"),company); kv(t("kPic"),pic+(picTitle?" ("+picTitle+")":"")); kv(t("kEmail"),$("email").value.trim());
  if($("phone").value.trim()) kv(t("kPhone"),$("phone").value.trim());
  y+=3; heading(t("pdfDetail"));
  const p=state.package;
  kv(t("kPackage"),p.name); kv(t("kBenefit"),p.benefits[state.lang].join(", "));
  kv(t("kForm"),state.type==="uang"?t("vMoney"):t("vGoods"));
  if(state.type==="uang") kv(t("kNominal"),rupiah(digits($("nominal").value)));
  else { kv(t("kGoodsDoc"),state.file.name+" ("+t("kAttached")+")"); const gv=digits($("goodsValue").value); if(gv) kv(t("kGoodsValue"),rupiah(gv)); }
  y+=3; heading(t("pdfTerms")); doc.setFontSize(8.5); doc.setTextColor(40);
  t("terms").forEach((s,i)=>{const lines=doc.splitTextToSize((i+1)+". "+s,TW); doc.text(lines,M,y); y+=lines.length*3.8+1;});

  y+=4;
  doc.setFontSize(9.5); doc.setTextColor(20); doc.text(CONFIG.city+", "+fmtDate(now),M,y); y+=6;
  const col=TW/2, x2=M+col+6, sigW=52, sigH=22;
  doc.setFont("helvetica","bold"); doc.text(t("sigOrg"),M,y); doc.text(t("sigPartner"),x2,y); doc.setFont("helvetica","normal"); y+=1;
  doc.addImage(randomSignature(),"PNG",M,y,sigW,sigH);
  doc.addImage(sigPartner,"PNG",x2,y,sigW,sigH);
  y+=sigH+1; doc.setDrawColor(60); doc.line(M,y,M+col-6,y); doc.line(x2,y,W-M,y); y+=4.5;
  doc.setFont("helvetica","bold"); doc.text(t("vSignatory"),M,y); doc.text(pic,x2,y); y+=4.5;
  doc.setFont("helvetica","normal"); doc.setTextColor(100); doc.setFontSize(8.5);
  doc.text(CONFIG.orgShort,M,y); doc.text(company,x2,y);
  doc.setFontSize(7.5); doc.text(t("sigFoot")+" "+now.toLocaleString(state.lang==="id"?"id-ID":"en-GB")+".",M,290);
  return doc.output("blob");
}

/* ================= KIRIM ================= */
$("send").onclick=async()=>{
  const e=$("err"); e.textContent="";
  const fail=k=>{e.textContent=typeof k==="string"?t(k):k;};
  if(!$("company").value.trim()) return fail("eCompany");
  if(!$("pic").value.trim()) return fail("ePic");
  if(!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test($("email").value.trim())) return fail("eEmail");
  if(!state.package) return fail("ePkg");
  if(!state.type) return fail("eType");
  let amount=0;
  if(state.type==="uang"){
    amount=digits($("nominal").value);
    if(!amount) return fail("eNominal");
    if(amount<state.package.min||amount>state.package.max) return fail(t("eRange")(state.package));
  } else {
    if(!state.file) return fail("eFile");
    amount=digits($("goodsValue").value);
  }
  if(pad.isEmpty()) return fail("eSign");
  if(!$("agree").checked) return fail("eAgree");

  const btn=$("send"); btn.disabled=true; btn.textContent=t("sending");
  try{
    state.pdfBlob=buildPDF(pad.data());
    let sentTo="";
    if(CONFIG.submitEndpoint){
      const fd=new FormData();
      fd.append("docNo",state.docNo); fd.append("company",$("company").value.trim()); fd.append("pic",$("pic").value.trim());
      fd.append("email",$("email").value.trim()); fd.append("phone",$("phone").value.trim());
      fd.append("package",state.package.name); fd.append("type",state.type); fd.append("amount",amount);
      fd.append("agreementPdf",state.pdfBlob,"Sponsorship-Agreement.pdf");
      if(state.file) fd.append("goodsList",state.file,state.file.name);
      const r=await fetch(CONFIG.submitEndpoint,{method:"POST",body:fd});
      if(!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP "+r.status);
      sentTo=$("email").value.trim();
    }
    state.doneEmail=sentTo;
    $("doneMsg").textContent = sentTo ? t("doneSent")(sentTo) : t("doneLocal");
    $("formView").classList.add("hidden"); $("doneView").classList.remove("hidden");
    window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"smooth"});
    download();
  }catch(err){
    e.textContent=t("eSend")(err.message);
  }finally{ btn.disabled=false; btn.textContent=t("send"); }
};
function download(){
  const a=document.createElement("a"); a.href=URL.createObjectURL(state.pdfBlob);
  a.download="Sponsorship-Agreement-"+$("company").value.trim().replace(/\W+/g,"-")+".pdf";
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
}
$("dl").onclick=download;

/* ================= INIT ================= */
let startLang="id"; try{ startLang=localStorage.getItem("lang")||"id"; }catch(e){}
applyLang(startLang==="en"?"en":"id");
requestAnimationFrame(()=>pad.fit());
</script>
</body>
</html>
